mode_a_standalone.title: Mode A: Fully Standalone / Faceless
mode_a_standalone.description: Zero on-camera presence. Driven entirely by high-velocity voiceover, dynamic kinetic typography, live UI captures, and story-driven visual metaphors.

visual_layering_stack.layer_1_background: Dynamic dark abstract motion background (#0B0D13) or ambient blurred screen recording
visual_layering_stack.layer_2_content: Full-bleed screen recordings of real software, web UI, or 3D visual metaphor graphics
visual_layering_stack.layer_3_overlays: High-contrast UI callout boxes, cursor zooms, glowing bounding boxes, progress rings
visual_layering_stack.layer_4_text: Centered kinetic subtitles (Font: Montserrat Black / Inter Bold, 64pt, Yellow highlight on active keywords, drop shadow)
visual_layering_stack.layer_5_hud: Minimalist creator watermark or corner category pill (e.g. [AI / AGENTS])

broll_and_asset_directives.real_ui_screenshots: Must show the real tool URL, real buttons, terminal executions, or official product page. Never generic stock images.
broll_and_asset_directives.visual_metaphors: Abstract concepts (e.g. 'Cloud Computer', 'Memory Buffer', 'GPU Cluster') must be visualized via 3D glass, glowing server racks, holographic blueprints, or isometric data nodes.
broll_and_asset_directives.audio_cues: Every scene change requires an audio cue: sub-bass thud on major points, whoosh on camera pans, mechanical keyboard click on code/UI reveals.

mode_b_on_camera.title: Mode B: With-Me-On-Camera (Presenter + Multi-Layer Compositing)
mode_b_on_camera.description: High-authority talking head presenter coupled with aggressive cutaways, picture-in-picture UI demonstrations, and hand-gesture-synced graphic overlays.

presenter_framing_and_delivery.framing: Medium close-up (chest to head), eyes at top third line. Slight lens tilt, moody high-contrast lighting (key light at 45 deg, subtle rim light).
presenter_framing_and_delivery.delivery: High vocal conviction, punchy staccato rhythm, natural forward lean into camera on the hook, quick glance/head nod towards virtual graphic overlays.
presenter_framing_and_delivery.gestures: Index finger flick when introducing point #1, palm push when rejecting an old paradigm, look-away glance when referencing the screen.

compositing_and_cutaway_rules.hook_0_3s: Presenter fills frame with urgent eye contact, punch-in zoom (1.15x) at word 4.
compositing_and_cutaway_rules.beat_transitions: Cut from full-screen presenter to full-bleed UI screencast or visual graphic for 1.8s, then return to presenter as a floating lower-right bubble (PiP), then back to full presenter.
compositing_and_cutaway_rules.graphic_placement: Graphics appear in the upper-left or floating beside presenter's head with subtle spring animation.
